title: User Authentication & Login
description: Users should be able to log in to their account using valid credentials, receive clear error messages for invalid attempts, and access the password recovery page if needed. - **Given** user is on the login page (`/login`) - **When** user enters valid username `testuser@example.com` - **And** user enters valid password `Password123!` - **And** user clicks the "Sign In" button
scenarios: Scenario 1: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
Scenario 2: Unsuccessful Login with Invalid Password
